title.en: Electric 60 from Xingtai Is the 90 kW, 40 m³/h Page
title.zh: 邢台的电动60是 90 kW、40 m³/h 那一页

description.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 60 at 90 kW, 40 m³/h, 35 MPa and hopper 0.7 m³. The low-pressure 60 page is 75 kW. Confirm 90 kW on the order.
description.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台把电动60印成 90 kW、40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³。低压60页是 75 kW。订单上要确认 90 kW。

h1.en: Put 90 kW on the Electric 60 Order
h1.zh: 在电动60的订单上写 90 kW

directAnswer.en: Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai prints Electric 60 as 90 kW, theoretical output 40 m³/h, 35 MPa, hopper 0.7 m³, fine stone 200 m / 600 m, 13 mm stone 150 m / 450 m, 24 mm stone 100 m / 300 m, frame 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm and 3300 kg. That outline matches Electric 80’s outline, not Electric 80’s 6000 kg or 110 kW. The order must say 90 kW and which stone row applies. Voltage is not printed. No price is printed.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械（邢台）把电动60印成 90 kW、理论输送量 40 m³/h、35 MPa、料斗 0.7 m³、细石 200 m / 600 m、13 mm 石子 150 m / 450 m、24 mm 石子 100 m / 300 m、外形 6600 × 1800 × 1800 mm、3300 kg。这组外形与电动80相同，但不是电动80的 6000 kg 或 110 kW。订单必须写 90 kW 以及适用的石子行。没有印电压。没有印价格。

body.en: The output cell is 40 m³/h. The numeral in the name is not the output.
body.zh: 输送量格是 40 m³/h。名称里的数字不是输送量。

body.en: HBT60-13.132 is on Diesel 60 and LZ-60. It is not the title of this electric page.
body.zh: HBT60-13.132 在柴油60和 LZ-60 上。它不是这张电动页的标题。

body.en: [/en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/](/en/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/) plus the stone row and site voltage, to [/en/contact/](/en/contact/).
body.zh: [/zh/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/](/zh/products/electric-60-concrete-pump/) 加上石子行和现场电压，发到 [/zh/contact/](/zh/contact/)。

answer.en: 0.7 m³, the same figure Electric 80 prints, on a different motor.
answer.zh: 0.7 m³，与电动80印的数字相同，电机不同。

answer.en: 3300 kg. Electric 80 on the same outline is 6000 kg.
answer.zh: 3300 kg。同一外形上的电动80是 6000 kg。

alt.en: Electric 60 concrete pump manufactured by Hebei Pinjin Machinery, a Xingtai concrete pump manufacturer
alt.zh: 电动60型混凝土泵，由河北品锦机械厂家制造，邢台
